units.en: At that time Wang Pu and Lu Yi were driven out. The emperor appointed Wang Zan and Zhao Chong as chancellors, but Yin insisted that neither was fit for the chancellorship, and the emperor had no choice but to dismiss them.
units.literal: At the time Wang Pu and Lu Yi were expelled; the emperor made Wang Zan and Zhao Chong chancellors; Yin insisted Zan and Chong were not chancellor material; the emperor had no choice but to dismiss them.

units.zh: 贊、崇皆偓所薦為宰相者。
units.en: Both Zan and Chong were men Wo had recommended for the chancellorship.
units.literal: Zan and Chong were both those Wo had recommended as chancellors.

units.zh: 全忠見帝，斥偓罪，帝數顧胤，胤不為解。
units.en: Quanzhong saw the emperor and denounced Wo's crimes. The emperor repeatedly looked toward Yin for help, but Yin offered no defense.
units.literal: Quanzhong saw the emperor and denounced Wo's crimes; the emperor repeatedly looked toward Yin; Yin did not speak in his defense.

units.zh: 全忠至中書，欲召偓殺之。
units.en: Quanzhong went to the Secretariat and wished to summon Wo and have him killed.
units.literal: Quanzhong came to the Secretariat and wished to summon Wo and kill him.

units.zh: 鄭元規曰：「偓位侍郎、學士承旨，公無遽。」
units.en: Zheng Yuangui said, "Wo holds the rank of vice minister and chief academician of the Hanlin Academy. My lord, you must not act in haste."
units.literal: Zheng Yuangui said: "Wo holds the rank of vice minister and chief academician—my lord, do not be hasty."

units.zh: 全忠乃止，貶濮州司馬。
units.en: Quanzhong thereupon desisted and demoted Wo to militia vice-prefect of Pu Prefecture.
units.literal: Quanzhong then stopped and demoted him to Militia Vice-Prefect of Pu.

units.zh: 帝執其手流涕曰：「我左右無人矣。」
units.en: The emperor took his hand with tears streaming down his face and said, "I have no one left at my side."
units.literal: The emperor grasped his hand with tears flowing and said: "I have no one left at my side."

units.zh: 再貶榮懿尉，徙鄧州司馬。
units.en: He was demoted again to defender of Rongyi and transferred to militia vice-prefect of Deng Prefecture.
units.literal: He was again demoted to Defender of Rongyi and moved to Militia Vice-Prefect of Deng.

units.zh: 天祐二年，復召為學士，還故官。
units.en: In the second year of Tianyou he was again summoned as an academician and restored to his former office.
units.literal: In the second year of Tianyou he was again summoned as academician and restored to his former office.

units.zh: 偓不敢入朝，挈其族南依王審知而卒。
units.en: Wo dared not enter court. He took his clan south to place themselves under Wang Shenzhi and died there.
units.literal: Wo dared not enter court, took his clan south to rely on Wang Shenzhi, and died.

units.zh: 兄儀，字羽光，亦以翰林學士為御史中丞。
units.en: His elder brother Han Yi, whose courtesy name was Yuguang, likewise rose from Hanlin academician to censor-in-chief.
units.literal: His elder brother Yi, style name Yuguang, also from Hanlin academician became Censor-in-Chief.

units.zh: 偓貶之明年，帝宴文思球場，全忠入，百官坐廡下，全忠怒，貶儀棣州司馬，侍御史歸藹登州司戶參軍。
units.en: In the year after Wo's demotion the emperor gave a feast at the Wensi ball ground. When Quanzhong entered, the officials were all seated beneath the corridor, and Quanzhong grew angry. He demoted Yi to militia vice-prefect of Di Prefecture and the attendant censor Gui Ai to registrar of Dengzhou.
units.literal: The year after Wo's demotion the emperor feasted at the Wensi ball ground; Quanzhong entered; the hundred officials sat beneath the corridor; Quanzhong was angry and demoted Yi to Militia Vice-Prefect of Di and Attendant Censor Gui Ai to Registrar of Dengzhou.

units.zh: 贊曰：懿、僖以來，王道日失厥序，腐尹塞朝，賢人遁逃，四方豪英，各附所合而奮。
units.en: The commentator says: From the reigns of Yizong and Xizong onward, the kingly way daily lost its proper order. Corrupt officials filled the court, worthy men fled into hiding, and heroes throughout the realm each attached themselves to whatever cause suited them and rose up in struggle.
units.literal: The commentator says: From Yizong and Xizong onward the kingly way daily lost its order; corrupt functionaries filled the court; worthy men fled; heroes of the four quarters each attached to what suited them and rose up.

units.zh: 天子塊然，所與者，惟佞愎庸奴，乃欲鄣橫流、支已顛，寧不殆哉！
units.en: The Son of Heaven stood isolated. Those around him were only flatterers, obstinate fools, and servile men. Yet he wished to block the rushing torrent and prop up a throne already toppling—how could he not be brought to ruin!
units.literal: The Son of Heaven stood alone; those he had were only flatterers, obstinate fools and slaves—yet he wished to block the rushing torrent and prop up his own collapse—would he not be imperiled!

units.zh: 觀綮、朴輩不次而用，捭豚臑，拒貙牙，趣亡而已。
units.en: Consider how men like Qi and Pu were promoted out of turn: it was like flinging a pig shank at a leopard's fangs—nothing but a rush toward destruction.
units.literal: Observing Qi, Pu and their sort used out of order—flinging pig shanks, repelling leopard fangs—they merely hastened ruin.

units.zh: 一韓偓不能容，況賢者乎？
units.en: If even a single Han Wo could not be tolerated, how much less could true men of worth!
units.literal: A single Han Wo could not be tolerated—how much less the worthy!

units.zh: 兄沆，廣明初亦為宰輔。
units.en: His elder brother Hong likewise reached the chief ministership early in the Guangming era.
units.literal: His elder brother Hong, at the beginning of Guangming also became a chief minister.

units.zh: 崔沂，
units.en: Cui Yi,
units.literal: Cui Yi,

units.zh: 四月，兵部尚書、權知貢舉姚洎奏：「近代設文科、選胄子，所以綱維名教，崇樹邦本也。
units.en: In the fourth month, Yao Ji, Minister of War and acting supervisor of the examinations, submitted: "The literary examination and selection of imperial scions were established in recent times to uphold the teachings and strengthen the foundation of the state.
units.literal: In the fourth month, Yao Ji, Minister of War and acting supervisor of the examinations, memorialized: "In recent times the literary examination and selection of imperial scions were established to maintain the teachings and exalt the foundation of the state.

units.zh: 梁開平元年七月，敕：「近年舉人，當秋薦之時，不親試者號為『拔解』，今後宜止絕。」
units.en: In the seventh month of Kaiping 1 of Liang, an edict declared: "In recent years, candidates recommended in autumn who skipped the trial examination were called 'pulling the recommendation'; this practice must cease."
units.literal: In the seventh month of the first year of Kaiping of Liang, an edict: "In recent years when candidates were recommended in autumn, those who did not take the trial examination were called 'pulling the recommendation'; from now on this should be stopped."

units.zh: 今在朝公卿親屬、將相子孫，有文行可取者，請許所在州府薦送，以廣疏材之路。」
units.en: Among the kin of court officials and the descendants of generals and ministers, any who show genuine literary merit should be allowed to be recommended and sent forward by their local prefecture or district, so that the path for discovering talent may be widened."
units.literal: Now among the kin of officials at court and the descendants of generals and ministers, any with literary conduct worth selecting—please allow the prefectures and districts where they reside to recommend and send them forward, to broaden the path for discovering talent."

units.zh: 從之。
units.en: The request was approved.
units.literal: Approved.

units.zh: 及賊巢渡江，罕之因以兵將背賊歸於唐，高駢錄其功，表為光州刺史。
units.en: When Chao crossed the Yangzi he defected to Tang; Gao Pian made him Guang commissioner.
units.literal: When bandit Chao crossed the river, Hanzhi therefore with troops turned his back on the bandits and returned to Tang; Gao Pian recorded his merit and memorialized him Guang prefecture military commissioner.

units.zh: 〈（《宋朝類苑》：和魯公凝有艷詞一編名《香奩集》，凝後貴，乃嫁其名為韓偓，今世傳韓偓《香奩集》，乃凝所為也。
units.en: 〈Classified Anecdotes of the Song Dynasty〉: He Duke of Lu Ning wrote passionate lyrics called Collection of the Perfumed Toilet. After he rose high he attributed them to Han Wo; the Han Wo collection transmitted today is Ning's.
units.literal: 〈Classified Anecdotes of the Song Dynasty〉: He Duke of Lu Ning had a volume of passionate lyrics called Collection of the Perfumed Toilet. After Ning rose high he married off the name to Han Wo; the Han Wo Collection of the Perfumed Toilet transmitted in the world today is in fact Ning's work.

units.zh: 丙寅，製金紫光祿大夫、行御史中丞、上柱國韓儀責授棣州司馬，侍御史歸藹責授登州司戶，坐百官傲全忠也。）
units.en: On bingyin an edict demoted Han Yi, grand master of the golden glow and purple ornament, acting censor, and supreme pillar of state, to defender of Dizhou, and remonstrating censor Gui Ai to registrar of Dengzhou, for the offense of officials' arrogance toward Quanzhong.)
units.literal: On bingyin, an edict demoted Grand Master of the Golden Glow and Purple Ornament, Acting Censor, and Supreme Pillar of State Han Yi to defender of Dizhou, and Remonstrating Censor Gui Ai to registrar of Dengzhou—for the offense of the hundred officials' arrogance toward Quanzhong.)

units.zh: 後党項大擾河西，邠寧節度使畢諴亦募士開營田，歲收三十萬斛，省度支錢數百萬緡。
units.en: When Tanguts ravaged Hexi, Binning commissioner Bi Xian recruited men for garrison farms, harvesting three hundred thousand hu a year and saving the treasury millions of strings.
units.literal: Later the Tangut greatly disturbed Hexi; Binning military commissioner Bi Xian also recruited men to open garrison fields, harvesting three hundred thousand hu yearly and saving several million strings for revenue administration.

units.zh: 甲寅，以太子賓客歸藹卒廢朝。
units.en: On jiayin Gui Ai, crown prince mentor, died and court was suspended.
units.literal: On jiayin, because Crown Prince Mentor Gui Ai died, court was suspended.

units.zh: 天復元年正月一日未旦，逆豎左軍容劉季述早入，德昭伏甲要路以俟，追其前驅，邀而斬之，孫承誨等分捕左軍容王仲先黨伍。
units.en: Tianfu 1, New Year's dawn, Dezhao ambushed and killed Liu Jishu; Chenghui seized Wang Zhongxian's faction.
units.literal: Tianfu year 1, first month, first day before dawn, rebel eunuch Left Army Rong Commissioner Liu Jishu early entered; Dezhao hid armor on the crucial road to wait, pursued his vanguard, intercepted and beheaded him; Sun Chenghui and the rest separately captured Left Army Rong Commissioner Wang Zhongxian's faction.

units.zh: 德昭馳至，扣閣曰：「逆賊劉季述伏誅矣，請上皇開鑰復皇帝位。」
units.en: Dezhao galloped up, knocked on the gate, and cried, "The rebel Liu Jishu has been executed—open the gate and restore the emperor!"
units.literal: Dezhao galloped to him, knocked on the gate and said: "Rebel bandit Liu Jishu has submitted to execution—beg the High Sovereign open the lock and restore the Son of Heaven's throne."

units.zh: 是歲四月，彗出西北，掃文昌、軒轅、天市，宰相柳璨希梁王旨，歸其譴於大臣，於是左僕射裴樞、獨孤損、右僕射崔遠、守太保致仕趙崇、兵部侍郎王贊、工部尚書王溥、吏部尚書陸扆皆以無罪貶，同日賜死於白馬驛。
units.en: That fourth month a comet swept the northwest heavens; Liu Can pleased Liang by blaming the ministers; Pei Shu, Dugu Sun, Cui Yuan, Zhao Chong, Wang Zan, Wang Pu, and Lu Yi were demoted without crime and executed the same day at White Horse Station.
units.literal: That year in the fourth month a comet appeared in the northwest, sweeping Wenchang, Xuanyuan, and the Celestial Market; Chief Minister Liu Can, hoping to please the Prince of Liang, laid the omen’s blame on the great ministers; thereupon Left Vice Director Pei Shu, Dugu Sun, Right Vice Director Cui Yuan, Retired Grand Preceptor Zhao Chong, Vice Minister of War Wang Zan, Minister of Works Wang Pu, and Minister of Personnel Lu Yi were all demoted without crime and on the same day ordered to die at White Horse Station.

units.zh: 大順二年，裴贄侍郎放第八人登科，正月十日放榜，正荀鶴生朝也。
units.en: In Dashun 2 Vice Minister Pei Zan placed him eighth on the list; the roster was posted on the tenth day of the first month—Xunhe's own birthday.
units.literal: In Dazhun year 2 Vice Minister Pei Zan released the eighth man on the rolls; on the tenth day of the first month the list was posted—exactly Xunhe's birthday.
